I visited Pulau Ketam, a car-free island off the coast of Selangor in Malaysia.

It was recommended to me by a local man in the previous vlog, and is apparently a popular day-trip location for people living in Selangor and Kuala Lumpur, but not many foreign tourists know about it.

I wanted to head over there early, to start exploring before the afternoon sun would make it unbearable, but I found myself at completely the wrong ferry port.

I went to the Port Klang Cruise Terminal, when I should have went to the Pork Klang South Passenger Terminal, and the two terminals are 30 minutes by road away from each other. Doh!

Never mind, I made it to Pulau Ketam eventually. There are bicycles and e-scooters available to rent at the port where you get dropped off but I decided to wander around on foot.
